papers.title: SHINE: Shear inference environment - Generative forward modelling for radio weak gravitational lensing
papers.summary: SHINE estimates cosmic shear from radio interferometric visibilities via forward generative modelling and posterior sampling in Fourier space, yielding sub-percent unbiased shear estimates.

papers.title: MAHA-z: A Mahalanobis distance kNN estimator for photometric redshifts
papers.summary: MAHA-z combines kNN regression with a Mahalanobis metric learned from spectroscopy to produce photometric redshifts and posteriors, reaching sigma_NMAD 0.015 on Euclid mocks.

papers.title: Extracting Published Discussions of 13,616 Galaxies with Language Models
papers.comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Artificial Intelligence for Scientific Publications (WASP) 2026
papers.summary: Language-model agents identify galaxies discussed across 156,006 arXiv papers, extracting 44,332 discussions and grouping them into 13,616 objects in GalaxyWiki.
